==Usage==
Copy the template code below, and paste it into an article's reference note. Fill in as many parameters as you can, remove any that you don't use.

Note that care must be taken to avoid an incorrect link.

<code><nowiki>{{SWBoards|url=|thread=|author=|date=|time=|quote=|archivedate=|archiveurl=|archivefile=|nobackup=}}</nowiki></code>

===Required parameters===
*{{Para|url}} The URL of the page, minus <code><nowiki>https://forums.starwars.com/</nowiki></code>.
*{{Para|thread}} Title of forum post. Note that it should be capitalized the same way as the original post's title.
*For '''archive link''', see [[#backup links|Backup links]] below.

===Optional parameters===
*{{Para|author}} Username of the forum post.
*{{Para|date}} Full date of publication, in [[Wikipedia:ISO 8601|ISO 8601]] <code>YYYY-MM-DD</code> format, for example "<code>date=2006-02-17</code>".
*{{Para|time}} Time of the forum post, in <code>HH:SS AM/PM</code> format, for example "<code>time=04:01 PM</code>".
*{{Para|quote}} Relevant quote from forum post. Double-quotes will be added automatically.

===Unneccesary parameters===
*{{Para|nolive}} As the original online content is no longer available, the template will automatically add "content now obsolete;" to the citation, and therefore does '''<u>NOT</u>''' require the use of "<code>|nolive=1</code>" like with other citation templates.

===Backup links===
{{BackupLinkHelp}}

==Example(s)==
<code><nowiki>{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=1125|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|author=[[Leland Chee|Tasty Taste]]|date=2006-12-28|time=04:01 PM|archivedate=20070303055750}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=1125|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|author=[[Leland Chee|Tasty Taste]]|date=2006-12-28|time=04:01 PM|archivedate=20070303055750}}
